verdict.rationale: A government agency's web platform could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index, so this axis applies. The later probe shows https://www.canada.ca/llms.txt redirects (302) to the canada.ca 404 error page. That resolves the earlier HTTP 200 reading as a soft 404, so no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs exist. Nothing else in the pack describes agent-facing documentation.
